implemented_hypotheses: Fresh completed LE16 grayscale acquisition is the shared virtual input; unit1 input qualification must have held from CMOS submission to completion.
Zero correction flags forward identity; unit2 nearest-samples grayscale to committed output dimensions. Physical color/filter coefficients and Bayer behavior are not implemented.

Paired control bit2 selects a256-entry LE16 LUT indexed by the high sample byte. Otherwise high16/14/12 sample bits are used. Samples form a little-endian bit stream;9530 remains retained without physical arithmetic.

The committed bank and initial/count ring select output slots. Every selected writable-RAM span and overlap is checked before row DMA. Padding persists; only successful whole-output DMA publishes raw0 mask18/raw4 mask80.

Both commit ports latch independently; equal commits retain cursor phase. Changed commits, stop/disable/unit/system reset cancel work. Stale input is not replayed, and pending frontend/paired/statistics data applies backpressure.
